licence.note: Written only by this build, once per craft execution/refusal. The fleet (ba84fa6) has no craftroom module.

exposure.note: Ready = >= 10 canary pickaxe crafts that sent clicks AND control server-lost pickaxe crafts >= 1 (positive control proven 10-03 23:35Z on craftsync-01 rows: 2 of 5).

own_lines.note: CORRECTNESS: more than ONE canary pickaxe craft the server saw lost (craftsync outcome=unconfirmed, confirmed=no, verify_source=resync, produced<=0, clicks>0). One is tolerated: a drop landing after the clicks start (known limit; detected, not preventable). Judged on >= 10 canary pickaxe crafts.
POSITIVE CONTROL: the server-lost query sees a presence on the control (which runs craftsync after its promotion). BLOCKS KEEP.
INSTRUMENT: > 5% of canary executions unanswered (after clicks, or baseline before any click) means Paper is not answering the resyncs this design relies on. Judged on >= 20. BLOCKS KEEP.
Any verified_local row means craftsync is not installed on a canary bot. BLOCKS KEEP.

primary.note: REPORTED, NOT GATED: lost-pickaxe rate DiD, refusals by kind (no_room, admission:*, pickup_pending, table_out_of_reach), table retakes, usable pickaxe holders canary vs control.
